turns.text: And you can ask yourself these questions.
turns.zh: 你可以问自己这些问题。

turns.text: Here's a checklist that you can go through.
turns.zh: 这里有一份清单，你可以逐项过一遍。

turns.text: Even though everybody hates the sound of their own voice it really is valuable.
turns.zh: 尽管每个人都讨厌听到自己的声音，但它真的很有价值。

turns.text: Ask yourself this did I speak fluently without noticeable effort?
turns.zh: 问问自己：我说话流利吗，有没有明显费力？

turns.text: Did I develop my topics coherently?
turns.zh: 我的话题展开得连贯吗？
你有没有把你的回答展开？
